about.title: About the Azurite Sea set
paragraphs: Azurite Sea is the 6th Disney Lorcana booster set, released on 25 November 2024. It has 222 cards: 204 in the main set and 18 Enchanted cards. There are also 204 foils, one for each main set card.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 204 main set cards), the Master set (408 cards, adding the foils) or the Grand Master set (all 426 cards, adding the Enchanted cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
